subject.title: fix(memory): memory search times out before returning keyword results

question: Should built-in memory search expose memory.search.query.primaryTimeoutMs as a public tuning option, or keep the bounded primary-embedding deadline as internal policy derived from the fixed tool deadline?
rationale: This PR adds a new persisted configuration/default surface for behavior that can be implemented with an internal deadline policy; repository guidance requires a high bar before expanding config.

options.title: Keep timeout policy internal
options.body: Derive a conservative primary budget from the remaining outer search deadline and avoid a new user-facing setting.

options.title: Approve a supported tuning option
options.body: Retain primaryTimeoutMs, but document upgrade behavior and prove that its maximum still preserves same-call fallback under delayed preliminary work.

recommendation.title: Keep timeout policy internal
recommendation.body: Derive a conservative primary budget from the remaining outer search deadline and avoid a new user-facing setting.
